<!--
Known and deliberate, so no need to report:

  - "Directions" for some venues goes to the town, not the door. About half the
    venues could not be matched to an exact building in OpenStreetMap; those
    hand the venue's name to Google to resolve instead.
  - "Showtimes" is a search rather than a direct link. Showtimes are licensed
    data that changes daily, and a static site cannot hold them honestly.
  - Some "Cinema site" links refuse to load. Several cinema chains block
    traffic by region or by automation; the link is usually fine from the
    country the theatre is in.
